title: Profile & Preferences
subtitle: Your account details, password, two-factor authentication and panel preferences.

account.title: Account Information
account.desc: Edit your full name and email address.

password.title: Password
password.desc: This changes the server's root password (including SSH access).
password.too_short: New password must be at least 8 characters.

twofa.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
twofa.desc: Requires a 6-digit code from an authenticator app in addition to your password at login.
twofa.step1: 1) Add it to your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, Microsoft Authenticator):
twofa.manual_hint: Can't scan? Use this secret key to enter it manually:
twofa.step2: 2) Enter the 6-digit code from the app:
twofa.disable_prompt: Enter your authenticator code to disable:
twofa.verify_failed_generic: Could not verify code — enter the 6-digit code from the app

nameserver.title: Nameservers
nameserver.desc: The shared nameserver pair customers delegate their domains to.
nameserver.help_admin: Customers enter these at their registrar. These hostnames MUST have A records pointing to this server's IP in your own DNS, otherwise no domain will resolve. After changing them, use "Migrate existing domains" to update old records.
nameserver.help_bayi: You can offer white-label nameservers. You must create A records for these hostnames pointing to the server IP at your own DNS provider. Leave empty to use the server-wide nameservers.
nameserver.migrate_confirm: NS records and SOA primary NS of all domains will be updated to the current nameserver pair and zones rewritten. Continue?
nameserver.suggested: The values below were guessed from your panel domain and are NOT saved yet. Verify them and save.

apitoken.title: API Tokens
apitoken.desc: Personal access tokens for automation and script access.
apitoken.name: Token name
apitoken.created_warning: ⚠️ This token is shown only once. Copy it somewhere safe — you will not be able to retrieve it after closing this box.
apitoken.empty: You have not created any tokens yet.
apitoken.confirm_delete: The token "{{ad}}" will be revoked. Scripts using it will stop working immediately. Continue?
apitoken.scope_note: A token acts with your account permissions — it can never do more than you can. If your account is suspended or your role changes, the token changes with it. Details: docs/API.md
